disclaimer: These hand-authored fixtures support demonstrations and regression tests only. They are not real-world validated data and must not be used as training data.

scenarios.message: Congratulations, you are shortlisted for an internship. Pay ₹799 as a registration fee today to confirm your seat.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Returns an uncertain high assessment with an employment-fee warning and safe verification guidance.

scenarios.message: Your refund is pending. Scan the QR code and enter your UPI PIN immediately to receive the amount.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Returns an uncertain critical assessment and tells the user not to scan, enter a PIN, or approve a request.

scenarios.message: Your account will be suspended today. Reply with your OTP to complete your KYC.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Returns an uncertain critical assessment because it requests a credential under account pressure.

scenarios.message: You are a prize winner. Pay a processing fee today to release your reward.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Returns an uncertain high assessment and advises against paying a claim fee.
scenarios.purpose: Demonstrates prize or lottery fee bait.

scenarios.message: Security reminder: Never share your OTP, password, or UPI PIN with anyone.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not treat protective OTP advice as a credential request and remains explicitly uncertain.
scenarios.purpose: Regression check for protective-language false positives.

scenarios.message: Payment confirmation: ₹799 was received successfully. Keep this receipt for your records.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not escalate an ordinary payment confirmation and does not claim it is safe.
scenarios.purpose: Regression check for ordinary payment language.

scenarios.message: Your parcel has been delivered. View its status in the delivery app you normally use.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not escalate an ordinary parcel notification and retains the safety limitation.

scenarios.message: We noticed a sign-in to your account. Review activity in the official app, and never share your OTP.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not confuse a protective account-security notice with account-pressure phishing.

scenarios.message: Please review the offer at https://bit.ly/offer.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Parses the URL locally and reports a shortening-service structural signal without opening it.
scenarios.purpose: Demonstrates safe local URL structure analysis.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Parses the URL locally and reports a numeric-host structural signal without treating its octets as subdomains.
scenarios.purpose: Regression check for IP-host URL classification.
